# Pearaing Birding Trails

> Community-based bird watching and temple tours in Cambodia, led by certified local guides in Siem Reap, Prek Toal, the Northern Plains and beyond.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Guided birding and temple tours across Cambodia.
- [About](/about): Our certified bird and temple guides.
- [Tours](/tours): Half-day, full-day and multi-day birding tours.
- [Young Bird Club](/tours/young-bird-club): Youth birding and conservation education.
- [Itineraries](/itineraries): Suggested birding routes around Cambodia.
- [Temple Tours](/temple-tours): Angkor and remote temple tours.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Bird and tour photography.
- [Conservation](/conservation): How our tours support habitat protection.
- [Contact](/contact): Enquiries and private tour planning.

## Birding Spots & Species

- [Birding in Siem Reap](/birding-siem-reap): Birding sites close to Siem Reap.
- [Prek Toal](/prek-toal): Tonle Sap waterbird sanctuary.
- [Giant Ibis](/giant-ibis): Where and when to see Cambodia's national bird.
- [Bengal Florican](/bengal-florican): Grassland sites for this critically endangered bustard.
- [Sarus Crane](/sarus-crane): Ang Trapaeng Thmor crane watching.
- [White-shouldered Ibis](/white-shouldered-ibis): Northern Plains dry forest specialty.
- [Green Peafowl](/green-peafowl): Sites and season for Green Peafowl.
- [Mekong Wagtail](/mekong-wagtail): Mekong river channel birding.
- [Cambodian Tailorbird](/cambodian-tailorbird): Cambodia's recently described endemic.
